promptTemplate: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original editorial cover illustration for the SoSho Studio bilingual technology journal. Subject: {subject}. Premium tactile 3D editorial art, frosted glass and brushed silver with restrained electric cyan and violet accents on deep midnight navy; cinematic soft studio illumination, convincing materials, carefully art-directed, minimal and sophisticated. Wide landscape 1.905:1 composition, central subject all within middle 65% so it survives a 21:9 crop; generous dark breathing room. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no chart values. Generate a finished high-resolution raster image.
